Class SmartMotorControllerConfig

java.lang.Object
yams.core.motorcontrollers.SmartMotorControllerConfig<SmartMotorControllerConfig>
yams.commands2.config.SmartMotorControllerConfig
public class SmartMotorControllerConfig extends SmartMotorControllerConfig<SmartMotorControllerConfig>
Command-based extension of SmartMotorControllerConfig that adds the Subsystem binding and command-layer helpers (e.g. live tuning) that core must not depend on.

Example

SmartMotorControllerConfig config = new SmartMotorControllerConfig(this)
    .withMotorInverted(false)
    .withStatorCurrentLimit(Amps.of(40));

    • withSubsystem

      public SmartMotorControllerConfig withSubsystem(org.wpilib.command2.Subsystem subsystem)
      Sets the Subsystem for the SmartMotorControllerConfig to pass along to SmartMotorController and the mechanisms built on it. Must be set if a Subsystem was not defined previously.
      Parameters:
      subsystem - Subsystem to use.
      Returns:
      SmartMotorControllerConfig for chaining.
      Throws:
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if a Subsystem has already been set, either through the constructor or a previous call to this method.
      Implementation Note:
      Does not copy the entire config, should NEVER be reused.

    • getSubsystem

      public org.wpilib.command2.Subsystem getSubsystem()
      Get the subsystem controlled by the SmartMotorController
      Returns:
      Subsystem controlled.
      Throws:
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if no Subsystem was set, i.e. the no-arg constructor (or a null subsystem) was used and withSubsystem(Subsystem) was never called.

    • setupLiveTuning

      public void setupLiveTuning()
      Set up live tuning for the SmartMotorController this config is attached to: registers a shared "Live Tuning" Command on getSubsystem() via SmartMotorControllerCommandRegistry that pulls tuned values from NetworkTables each loop, and registers cleanup so the registration is removed when the controller is closed.
      Overrides:
      setupLiveTuning in class SmartMotorControllerConfig<SmartMotorControllerConfig>
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if a different Subsystem instance with the same name has already registered a "Live Tuning" command.
